# Whyte Plumbing

Whyte Plumbing, Inc. is a family plumbing shop in Northridge, California.
Run by David Lawrence Whyte, known as the Pipe Doctor, with his son Daniel.
In the trade since 1979 and incorporated in 1988.
California C-36 plumbing license No. 549658.
Work includes leak detection, slab leak repair, drain cleaning, sewer repair, video pipe inspections, hydro-jetting, and tankless water heaters.
Serves Northridge, the San Fernando Valley, Greater Los Angeles, and nearby Orange and Ventura counties.
Office phone (818) 885-8222 and cell (818) 402-5311.
Email thepipedr@aol.com.
Shop at 8736 Jumilla Ave, Northridge, CA 91324.
Call or email for a diagnosis and a repair quote.
